issue_title: Persistent performance below 85: /projects (65) and /projects/screenshot-to-primevue (65) with high LCP
issue_body: ## Persistent performance regression — /projects and /projects/screenshot-to-primevue *Audited at 2026-08-09T09:02:20.188Z* While the homepage has largely recovered from yesterday's regression (53 → 84), two pages continue to score 65 on performance — well below the 85 threshold — driven primarily by slow LCP. ### Score summary | Page | Performance | LCP | TBT | |---|---|---|---| | `/projects` | **65** | **5583 ms** | 205 ms | | `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` | **65** | **6574 ms** | 74.5 ms | Note: `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` LCP has worsened from 4134 ms → 6574 ms (+2440 ms) compared to the previous audit. ### Likely causes 1. Large unoptimized project card/thumbnail images on `/projects` loading eagerly without preload hints. 2. The three sample screenshot thumbnails on `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` are likely not served in a next-gen format (WebP/AVIF) and may lack explicit dimensions. 3. No `fetchpriority="high"` or `` on the LCP image candidate. ### Suggested actions - [ ] Identify the LCP element on each page using Lighthouse trace and add `fetchpriority="high"` to it. - [ ] Convert project thumbnail images to WebP/AVIF and serve appropriately sized variants via `srcset`. - [ ] Add explicit `width` and `height` attributes to all thumbnail `` elements to prevent layout shifts. - [ ] Consider lazy-loading below-the-fold project cards while keeping above-the-fold ones eager. ### Also ongoing - `/about` remains a content stub (placeholder text only) — pre-existing issue. - `/projects/note-structurer` performance is 79 (below 85) with LCP 4126 ms — worth monitoring. *Previous regression issue: homepage-performance-regression-tbt-lcp (filed 2026-08-08) — homepage has recovered.*
